comment: Self-hosted financial data MCP server. Run locally via Docker:
Web portal: http://localhost:8080  |  MCP SSE: http://localhost:8081/sse
Form 3/4 insider trades, congressional disclosures, FINRA short volume,
SEC fails-to-deliver, FRED economic indicators, CFTC futures, CBOE VIX/put-call,
daily prices + technical indicators. No cloud dependency, no API keys required.
Set mcp.equibles.enabled: true in config.yaml once the container is running.
OpenResearch MCP server — exposes all four research pipelines as native tools.
Prerequisites: pip install mcp  (adds the mcp package).
run_interview_prep(jd_text, company_name, role_title, profile_text?, depth?) → InterviewPrepBrief JSON
run_real_estate_research(city, state, address?, depth?, bedrooms?, purchase_price?, ...) → RealEstateBrief JSON
Pipelines are initialised lazily on first call — startup is instant.
All logs go to stderr; stdout is reserved for the MCP stdio transport.
